measurement.table_basis: Absolute times are medians. Relative overhead is median of within-pair ratios; it need not equal the ratio of the displayed absolute medians.
limitations: Local desktop measurements; CPU frequency and unrelated host activity are not controlled.
One P, preemption OFF; this does not measure async preemption or multi-core scaling.
All modes execute the same kernel. Auto has one equivalent family member; this measures integration/admission overhead, not optimized implementation selection.
Manual bypasses Magic2 execution while using the same executable; this is not a compile-time removal or binary-size measurement.
